svg.title: Linky
svg.desc: Short links, branded QR codes and link-in-bio pages with click analytics, a REST API and signed webhooks. Every feature free and self-hostable. No tiers every feature free; OpenAPI 3.1 REST API; HMAC signed webhooks.
